provenance.prompt:
Create a native pixel-art game animation sprite atlas for adult TIFA LOCKHART from ORIGINAL FINAL FANTASY VII (1997), matching the attached existing game references exactly for identity/style: long dark brown hair with a tied flowing end, white sleeveless crop top, black suspenders, short black skirt, belt, red leather martial-arts gloves/wrist guards, red-brown combat boots and socks. Keep the same outfit and consistent adult proportions in every frame. Original 1997 outfit, no Remake black under-top redesign. She fights UNARMED using real fists, elbows, knees and kicks: absolutely no sword, staff, gun, shield, summoned creature, laser, magic orb or copied Cloud pose. Compact detailed crisp pixel sprite rendering with readable face and limbs, not a photorealistic painting. All subjects face right, with natural torso rotation. Transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, horizon, shadows on ground, painted ledge, grid lines, labels, text, borders or decoration. Exactly FOUR equal columns, four sequential full-body poses per row, no fifth figure or duplicate. All hair, glove, fingers and boot tips must stay inside their own cell with transparent gutters, at least 24 transparent pixels between the complete subject and each cell boundary. Keep head/body size consistent between rows; allow room for long hair without overlap. Each frame must change limb anatomy, torso bend, hand position and balance visibly: not a translated duplicate and not a pose changed only by color or glow. NO energy effects, punch trails, detached white flecks or blue swooshes anywhere. Every row is a different named state, not a continuation of the previous row. This is newly generated 2D adapted animation, not traced official game frames.
Portrait 1:2 canvas, ideally 1024x2048, EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS = 32 full sprites. Grounded soles share a common row baseline. Choreography:
Row1 attackLight1: quick left straight jab. Frame1 left fist at cheek and rear right fist protecting jaw → frame2 lead left arm extending with knee bend → frame3 full forward jab with hip twist and right fist kept by cheek → frame4 left fist retracts and weight returns. Four distinct arm and leg postures.
Row2 attackLight2: right cross punch. Rear right fist chambers by ribs, left glove forward → right shoulder and hip drive forward with rear heel lifting → right arm fully extended and left glove protecting face, legs in forward lunge → right fist draws back as torso counter-rotates. No kick in this punch row.
Row3 attackLight3: short rising uppercut finisher. Lowered rear fist and deeply bent knees → elbow lifts and fist passes in front of chest → rising right fist above shoulder while body straightens and lead knee opens → high-fist follow-through and controlled step back into guard. Keep both boots visible.
Row4 crouchLight: low body punch from a crouch. Squat with fists tucked → low left fist punches right at waist level, hips turn while knees remain bent → full low extension with rear elbow guarding → low retracted glove and crouch guard. Never stand upright in this row.
Row5 chargeStart: physical punch windup. Upright boxing guard → lead boot plants wider and knees flex while rear fist pulls back → deep hip coil with rear elbow behind ribs and lead palm guarding face → tight low braced stance, rear fist cocked beside hip, torso fully wound. Four unmistakable levels of preparation, no glowing ball.
Row6 chargeLoop: held physical readiness, NOT attacks. Rear fist stays chambered and elbows remain bent in all four. Frame1 deep rear-weighted stance with left glove forward → frame2 lower knees and elbows draw closer while weight centers → frame3 head turns slightly with torso twist and lead knee opens, glove still unextended → frame4 wider stance, rear heel braces and elbows lift into compact guard. Four distinct held bracing anatomies, no extended strike.
Row7 chargeRelease: powered BEAT RUSH punch sequence, the actual secondary technique. Frame1 low cocked fists and torso driving forward → frame2 deep lunging left straight punch while right fist guards → frame3 opposite right cross at chest height, hips fully rotate and left fist retracts → frame4 both elbows bent after the final punch with weight far forward and knees absorbing momentum. Real rapid punches, not Final Heaven energy blast, not uppercut-only.
Row8 chargeRecovery: recover from Beat Rush. Low forward follow-through, lead arm bent down → rear foot steps under hips, fists draw inward → torso rises and forearms move before chest → fully balanced boxing guard with knees softly bent. Four clearly different body positions.

nativeCorrections.prompt:
Native pixel-art sprite correction, TIFA LOCKHART original FINAL FANTASY VII (1997), matching the attached sprite reference exactly: long flowing dark brown hair tied at end, white sleeveless top, black suspenders and short black skirt, red martial-arts gloves and red boots. Adult proportions, same crisp detailed pixel rendering. UNARMED, no sword, gun or props. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, shadow, labels, grid, text or effects.
ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of EXACTLY FOUR full-body sprites, equally spaced in FOUR equal cells. Wide landscape 4:1 canvas if possible, ideally1024x256. Every hair tip, glove and boot stays inside its cell with transparent margins. This is the missing chargeLoop state, a SUSTAINED PHYSICAL WINDUP, NOT an attack. In ALL FOUR poses both elbows MUST stay visibly bent; neither fist may extend into a punch. NO strike, NO punching, NO kick, NO magic, NO glowing ball, NO energy aura, NO identical or shifted copies. Four different body silhouettes:
FRAME1: low broad boxing stance, most weight on deeply bent back knee, rear right fist tightly chambered at hip and lead left glove protecting cheek, torso coiled back.
FRAME2: visibly deeper symmetric squat, both knees bend far outward, both fists pulled into a compact guard against the ribs with elbows tucked, head lower than frame1.
FRAME3: forward knee strongly bent and rear leg stretched diagonally back, torso twisted inward and both forearms crossed tightly before chest, fists near opposite shoulders. Entirely held coiled preparation, NOT a punched arm.
FRAME4: weight draws back again, knees staggered at different heights, elbows rise outward while both fists stay next to cheeks, torso more upright, ready to cycle to frame1.
Use actual anatomical changes of hips, shoulders, bent elbows and knees. All four poses are DISTINCT HOLDING/BRACING postures, not four stages of releasing a punch. Long hair follows the different torso angles. Keep consistent character size and sole baseline. No motion trail fragments and no disconnected pixels between sprites. These are newly drawn adapted game poses, not official FFVII frames.
nativeCorrections.reason: The initial combat-a native source contains only seven state rows; chargeLoop was omitted. Its valid chargeStart, Beat Rush release and recovery rows are retained; this new source supplies the missing four held poses.
